criterion: HARD requires reconciling two locations, an ordering judgement, or noticing an absence. EASY is decidable at a single location.
note: This classification was applied in the paper but had never been written down; it is recorded here so the split can be recomputed rather than asserted.

hard.V08: absence — no ORCID iD is present anywhere
hard.V09: absence — required address components are missing
hard.V10: ordering — sections appear in the wrong order
hard.V11: absence — no Data availability section exists
hard.V13: ordering — Acknowledgements placed after the reference list
hard.V14: two locations — statement sits in the Introduction, not the required section
hard.V15: absence + cross-reference — Table 1 is never cited in the body
hard.V16: ordering + cross-reference — citation order does not match table numbering
hard.V20: absence + cross-reference — Figure 3 is never cited in the body
hard.V21: ordering — Figure 2 is cited before Figure 1
hard.V26: two locations — the caption repeats the article title verbatim
hard.V39: two locations — animal work in Methods, no approval in the ethics statement
hard.V40: two locations — the statement covers 3 of the 5 listed authors
